headline: Omnicom Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
summary: Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) will publish its third quarter 2026 results on Thursday, October 22, 2026 after the New York Stock Exchange close of trading. The company will also host a conference call to review such financial results on Thursday, October 22, 2026, starting at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time. A live webcast of the call will be available at Omnicom's investor relations website, investor.omc.com, along with the related earnings press release and slide presentation. A webcast replay will be made avail
